results.check: 2e. Races between the new tasks (scratch scripts link-race.mjs and race.mjs)
results.evidence: A second pick while building (scenario 11) settles the same on both. A link arriving by popstate to ?g=D4&k=2 at 40 ms and at 300 ms after a pick of E6 gives the same result on both: D4 node 2, pickers D4 and 2/4. On the branch, a link arriving exactly after the new `picked` step also ends at D4 node 2 with consistent pickers, because load() clears `picked`. New problem: a node chosen from the node picker in the window between the `picked` step and the loading task (one afterFrame). pickNode builds `spec` (the old state's board) while the picker already lists the new board's labels. A MutationObserver that chose node 3 when the node picker first listed 6 options while the facts still said A2 produced, on the branch, pageerror 'label 3 is not on this board'. The tool then stayed stuck: facts A2, line 'Building A2, node 3.', data-drawn=false, 5 pieces waiting, pickers E6 and 3/6. From E7, choosing node 4 in the window built E7 node 4. On the base the observer never fired, because the node picker shows the old board's labels until the state loads.

sideEffects: New race in a window of about one frame: the pickers show the picked board one step before the state loads (`picked`), but pickNode still builds the old state's `spec`. A node chosen in that window builds the wrong board. A label the old board lacks leaves T12 stuck: pageerror 'label 3 is not on this board', the 'Building A2, node 3.' line, data-drawn=false, panels showing 'Drawing.'. Reproduced only with a MutationObserver that acts at that moment; impossible on the base.

The DOM after a pick is not literally unchanged, as the repair report says: each adopted grid sits inside a <div class="adopted"> (display: contents) in its .box, 7 after a pick of E6 against 0 on the base. There is no visible, hook, axe or test difference, and the hydrated default state already had this structure on the base.
A pick takes more tasks to settle: the median duration of the long-task test at 4x went from 3.7 s on the base to 3.9 to 4.0 s on the branch.
Size: /tools/rep/ and M8 are 87.8 kB (86.8 kB at the base per the repair report), leaving about 2.2 kB of the 90 kB budget.
Not caused by the repair, seen on both builds: a link (popstate) arriving while a pick builds leaves the 'Building E6.' line on screen, because load() does not clear `building`.
